name: Green Island
description: Green Island, a coral cay 27 km off Cairns in the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park and Green Island National Park, with the reefs of the Cairns day trips around it: Arlington Reef, Upolu Cay and Michaelmas Cay. Rebuilt from 30 m survey bathymetry and Sentinel-2; the cays' ground is rebuilt from their mapped outlines.
area_note: Green Island and its reef with the Arlington reef complex to the north (Arlington Reef, Upolu Cay, Vlasoff Reef, Michaelmas Reef and Cay): the offshore reefs of the Cairns day trips, 26.6 x 33.6 km. The Cairns waterfront, 27 km south-west, is left out: taking it in as well would need about 45 km, and its 20 km of turbid inshore water would bias the scene-wide water optics (one Kd for the scene) that the reefs are inverted with; the town would also be flat, with no buildings in this pipeline. Boats from Cairns enter through a gate in the south-west corner.

poi_sources.osm: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), read through Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0 base land and infrastructure: a point on the feature (for areas the centroid or a point on the surface, checked to lie on it). The `osm` field names the object.
poi_sources.nominal: chosen for the viewer: boat spots, which the boats search near for water 5-9 m deep, and one snorkel spot placed where QPWS describes snorkelling
poi_sources.not mapped: no snorkel or dive sites are mapped in OSM or Overture around Green Island; the beach and the cay's reef are mapped without names, so they carry descriptive names here

tide.note: Cairns Beacon C1 (16 49 S 145 49 E in MSQ's 2026 tide tables) stands in open water in Trinity Bay, 18 km west-south-west of Green Island. MSQ lists Green Island as a secondary place of the Cairns standard port (16 55 S 145 46 E, in Trinity Inlet) with high and low water 6 minutes earlier and a similar range (MHWS-MLWS 1.9 m against 1.85 m); the beacon's tide runs about 6 minutes ahead of the inlet gauge's (M2 phase 3 degrees earlier in the 2026 fit) with 4% less M2, so the open-water gauge is the closer match. Times and heights at Green Island still differ by a few minutes and centimetres.
